business_problem: The challenge: Post-trading processes with data silos and local copies
solution_summary: The challenge: Post-trading processes with data silos and local copies Every day, Clearstream carries out more than 250,000 settlement transactions, while holding more than 300,000 nationally and internationally traded bonds, securities, shares, and investment funds in custody. That's another way of saying that this subsidiary and central securities depository of Deutsche Börse Group carries a great deal of responsibility. With a total data volume of 400 terabytes being processed every day, regular data reconciliation and ongoing maintenance are essential for making transaction decisions and ensuring efficient operations. "To access centralized data from diverse data sources for efficient analysis and to foster innovation and business agility, we use a data platform," says Priya Sharma In the past, however, the data platform was hosted locally, which in practice often led to the creation of silos and multiple copies of files.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and transforms large datasets for analytics, modeling, and downstream reporting.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Runs the customer's containerized applications and AI services on a managed Kubernetes platform.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

data_flow: Operational and business data is gathered from the customer's source systems processed in Azure Databricks and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
